description:
FILED s464aw (measured while shipping #972's `nomethod' arm; PRE-EXISTING --
identical on an 80b715c worktree).

    package OwnInc;
    use overload q(++) => sub { "INCED" }, q("") => sub { "OI" }, q(0+) => sub { 7 };
    my $a = OwnInc->new; $a++;
    perl:  ref($a) = OwnInc   "$a" = OI      <- the RETURN IS DISCARDED
    PCL :  ref($a) = ""       "$a" = INCED   <- the return REPLACES the place

    my $b = OwnInc->new; my $c = ++$b;
    perl:  $c = OI    ref($b) = OwnInc
    PCL :  $c = INCED ref($b) = ""

perl treats a `++'/`--' handler as a MUTATOR of `$_[0]' and throws the return
value away; PCL stores it, which DECLASSES the object.  Confirmed twice from
the other side: with a `nomethod' key and no `++'/`+', `$x++' calls nomethod
once (op=`++', other=undef, swapped='') and leaves `$x' holding the same
blessed object.

The comment in `%p-incdec-overload' asserts the opposite ("a mutator whose
return value is what the place receives") and is WRONG -- it was written in
#900 without this probe.

NOT FIXED BY #972, deliberately: #972 only added the `nomethod' arm, which
DOES discard (perl's measured behaviour, with the asymmetry called out in the
code comment).  Changing the OWN-handler arm is a behaviour change for every
class with a `++'/`--' key -- of which there are ZERO in cpan-tests/ + lib/ +
perl-tests/ + perl's own t/ (grepped: 0 hits for `'++' =>'), so the corpus
cannot measure it and the guard rows ARE the bar.

CAUTION: the fix must not break perl's AUTOGENERATED `++'-from-`+', where the
result DOES replace the place (`$x = $x + 1'); that path is a different arm
(`%p-incdec-autogen') and is already correct.

BAR: the four rows above vs perl; the sweep; extend Pl/t/raw-verdict-01.t's
#900/#934 rows (BOTH emission paths -- the raw slot reaches
`perl-increment' by its own route).

=== DONE (s470bk) ===
FIXED, own commit, runtime-only.  One line in `%p-incdec-overload`'s
own-handler arm: call the handler, then answer VAL.  The arm's comment
asserted the opposite and is corrected with the reason.

The `nomethod` arm three lines below has DISCARDED since #972 from its own
measurement, and the code carried the asymmetry as a comment; the two arms are
perl's two questions about the same mutator and they agree now.  The
AUTOGENERATED `++`-from-`+` (`%p-incdec-autogen`'s `gen` arm) is untouched â
there the result really is `$x = $x + 1` and REPLACES the place, and each new
guard row's last line proves it.

MEASURED: 7 rows one file, perl 5.40.3 vs `./runpcl`, on BOTH `PCL_OPT` paths,
byte-identical.  An eighth row had to go: perl DIES on `my $f = $e++` for such
a class (`Operation "=": no method found` â it wants the `=` copy constructor),
which is #1006(a).

Corpus exposure is ZERO by measurement, so the guard rows ARE the bar:
`Pl/t/raw-verdict-01.t` 58 -> 60 rows plus a new `AoMut` fixture module whose
handlers return a STRING.  That shape matters â the existing `AoInc` fixture
returns `$_[0]`, which is why storing and discarding coincided there and 58
green rows never saw this.  Inverse-verified on a `92a568e` worktree.
subject: a ++/-- overload handler is a MUTATOR: perl DISCARDS its return value, PCL stores it
